name: Drover
where_agents_run: Your computer, on your own Claude Code or Codex sign-in
license: Closed source; free during the beta
source_note: Checked rundrover.com: homepage, all seven docs pages, download page, changelog, beta terms, its release feed (/api/releases) and the README of its public feedback repo. The app itself has no public repo. Not installed or run here.

multi_provider_supervision.value: Claude Code and Codex, mixable by stage

needs_you_signal.value: Needs your input list holds every waiting decision

approve_deny_prompt.value: Approve plans, answer questions, grant retries; command prompts not in docs

cross_provider_delegation.value: Plan, build and review can each use a different agent

always_on_assistant.value: Attendant: Ask answers with sources, acts after you confirm

conversation_gui_view.value: Live log of reads, edits and agent updates; not a chat

agent_context_view.value: Live log shows the files each agent reads

real_terminal.value: Not in its docs; shows tickets and logs, not terminals

session_organization.value: One ticket queue across repos; active tickets by stage

builtin_editors_browser.value: Changes tab shows each task's diffs; no editor or browser

limit_governor.value: Not in its docs; caps retries per ticket, not usage

vault_task_source.value: Not in its docs; tickets from trackers or typed in

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues: ticket to merge, result written back

worktree_management.value: Makes worktrees; rebases, retests, then merges, opens a PR or pushes

planner_orchestrator.value: Planner splits a ticket into tasks; a second agent reviews the plan

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: Not in its docs; stages hand work along a fixed line

remote_ssh.value: Not in its docs; works on local repositories

requirements.value: GitHub sign-in, Git, Claude Code or Codex signed in; gh for PRs

app_shell.value: Desktop app plus a separate local driver; framework not named

background_process.value: Yes: a background attendant; tray icon

download_size.value: v0.1.35: 11 MB Windows installer, 95 MB Linux AppImage, 18 MB deb

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Not measured; no memory figure found

license_cost.value: Closed source; free beta; you pay your agent provider

extensibility.value: Command line to start and queue tickets; no plugins found

notable_extras.value: Stops tickets too big to plan and proposes a split
